answer: Unverified network nodes form a hollow capacity bubble that distorts throughput by masking single-source routing behind multiple fake origins. Injecting this synthetic traffic creates a plume of congestion that starves legitimate data flows of bandwidth at critical computational bottlenecks. Deploying strict proof-of-work transit tolls flattens this traffic mesa by imposing a high energy tax per route, forcing attackers to pay unsustainable compute costs while letting valid traffic bypass the queue.
